home.hello: {from} → {to}: type a word and press Enter.
home.tip: Tip: {key} brings Lex Studio up from any program — with the copied word already looked up. Esc hides it again.
home.tipScript: Greek, Russian and Japanese can be typed with Latin letters (logos → λογος, sobaka → собака, inu → いぬ). Accents, macrons and breathings are not needed.
err.offline: No internet connection — Wiktionary could not be reached. Words looked up before still work offline.
err.rateLimit: Wiktionary asks for a short pause (too many requests). Try again in a minute.
res.noTarget: No direct translation into {lang} found — the meanings below help.
res.viaHint: There is no direct table for this pair of languages: these are the translations of the English word.
res.wordHint: Click: copy · double-click or Ctrl/⌘-click: look it up the other way round
res.cached: Saved earlier (works offline). ↻ fetches it again.
res.partial: Some pages could not be loaded — the answer may be incomplete.
list.empty:
Your word list is empty.
The ☆ next to a word puts it here — to learn it later or to export it.
list.title: Word list ({n})
list.hint: The CSV file (word; translation) can be imported into Plan Studio's flashcards, Anki or Excel.
list.clearAsk: Remove all words from the list?
toast.pinned: Stays in front of other windows
csv.name: Word list
key.taken: {key} is already used by another program — pick another one.
key.invalid: This key combination does not work.
set.title: Settings
set.languageHint: The language of the window (shared with the other Studio apps).
set.translit: Latin letters for Greek, Russian and Japanese
set.translitHint: logos → λογος, sobaka → собака, inu → いぬ
set.autoScript: Switch the language by the script (Greek, Cyrillic, Japanese letters)
set.hotkeyHint: Works in every program: brings the window up — or hides it when it is already in front.
set.clipboardHint: When the key combination brings the window up: copy a word anywhere (⌘C / Ctrl+C), press the keys, the translation is there.
set.hideOnBlur: Hide when another window is clicked
set.background: Keep running when the window is closed
set.backgroundHint: The key combination keeps working; the icon in the menu bar / tray brings the window back and quits.
set.sourceHint: From Wiktionary, the free dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0): German meanings from de.wiktionary.org, translation tables and English meanings from en.wiktionary.org. Needs the internet; nothing about you is sent, only the word.
set.cacheHint: {n} words are kept on this computer, so they come at once and work offline (renewed after 30 days).
